Electromed, Inc. Delivers Continued Growth in Fiscal 2027 First Quarter 

 

16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year revenue and operating income growth

 

NEW PRAGUE, Minn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Electromed, Inc. (“Electromed”) (NYSE American: ELMD), a leader in innovative airway clearance technologies, today announced financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026 (“Q1 FY 2027”).

 

Q1 FY 2027 Company Highlights

 

 

●

Net revenues were $18.7 million in Q1 FY 2027, a 10.6% increase from $16.9 million in the first quarter of the prior fiscal year, driven by a 17.6% increase in the core homecare market.

 

 

●

Operating income increased to $3.5 million, a 30.7% increase from the first quarter of the prior fiscal year, and 18.7% of net revenues.

 

 

●

Net income was $2.8 million, or $0.32 per diluted share, representing an increase of 29.3%, compared to $2.1 million, or $0.25 per diluted share in the first quarter of the prior fiscal year.

 

 

“We delivered our 16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year revenue and operating income growth, with double-digit revenue growth, a 30.7% increase in operating income and an 80.0% gross margin—demonstrating the strength of our direct-to-patient model and operating leverage. We also returned $4.3 million to shareholders through share repurchases while remaining debt-free. With a strong balance sheet and high-performing sales and fulfillment teams, Electromed is well positioned to bring SmartVest® therapy to more patients who need to breathe easier,” said Jim Cunniff, President and Chief Executive Officer.

 

 

Q1 FY 2027 Results

 

All amounts below are for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and compare to the three months ended September 30, 2025 (“Q1 FY 2026”).

 

Net revenues grew 10.6% to $18.7 million, from $16.9 million.

 

Revenue in our direct homecare business increased by 17.6% to $17.5 million, from $14.9 million. The increase in revenue was primarily due to an increase in sales representatives and increased sales representative productivity. Throughout Q1 FY 2027, we averaged 63 homecare field sales representatives. The annualized homecare revenue per weighted average direct sales representative in Q1 FY 2027 was $1,109,000, within Electromed’s target range for the year of $1,050,000 to $1,150,000.

 

Non-homecare revenue was $1.2 million. Hospital revenue was $0.7 million, a decrease of 31.6%. Homecare distributor revenue was $0.4 million, a decrease of 55.9%. Other revenue was $0.1 million, a decrease of 23.0%.

 

Gross profit increased year-over-year to $14.9 million or 80.0% of net revenues from $13.2 million or 78.1% of net revenues. The increase in gross profit was primarily a result of increased overall revenue and the increase in gross profit percentage was due to revenue mix.

 

 
 

 

Selling, general and administrative (“SG&A”) expenses were $11.2 million, representing an increase of $0.9 million, or 8.6%. The increase in the current period was primarily due to increased salaries and incentive compensation, travel and meals related to the higher average sales representative headcount and higher overall compensation costs.

 

Operating income was $3.5 million or 18.7% of net revenues, compared to $2.7 million, or 15.8% of net revenues. The 30.7% increase in operating income was primarily due to the increases in revenue and gross profit.

 

Net income increased by 29.3% to $2.8 million, or $0.32 per diluted share, compared to $2.1 million, or $0.25 per diluted share.

 

As of September 30, 2026, Electromed had $15.9 million in cash, $30.3 million in accounts receivable and no debt, achieving a working capital of $44.9 million and total shareholders’ equity of $52.5 million. The cash balance reflects a decrease of $4.6 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to a decrease in cash of $1.2 million in the three months ended September 30, 2025. The decrease in cash for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was driven primarily by share repurchases of $4.3 million of Electromed common stock.

About Electromed, Inc.

 

Electromed, Inc. manufactures, markets, and sells products that provide airway clearance therapy, including the SmartVest® Airway Clearance System, to patients with compromised pulmonary function. It is headquartered in New Prague, Minnesota, and was founded in 1992. Further information about Electromed can be found at www.smartvest.com.
